findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a light articulatory coloring in the word that names the tongue-language itself.

findings.title: The personal medium bridges act and commission

findings.title: One purpose contains two speech acts

epistemic.reason: The particle's direct scope and extension through coordination are specified by focus attachment evidence.

findings.title: Purpose is visible in the attached form

findings.title: A paired mission with distinct recipients

findings.containment: The grammatical split describes roles in this ayah; it does not prove the audiences are fixed or incapable of overlap.

epistemic.reason: The verb coordination and the two object phrases are locally supplied.

findings.title: The addressee is commissioned to proclaim

findings.containment: This is a role encoded by the local verb and syntax, not an added account of how the message was received.

findings.title: One prepared message meets two audience postures
findings.claim: The verse describes one facilitated revelation, carried through the addressee's language, turning toward good tidings for a self-guarding class and warning for a fiercely disputatious collective.

The HFT trace attributes these linked branch roles to the focus words, whose supplied roots, word indices, and returns match the Arabic surface.

findings.title: Good tidings and warning as advance notice
findings.claim: The paired speech acts can be heard as two kinds of advance notice: glad tidings disclose what is beginning, while warning reports danger early enough to orient protection.
findings.mechanism: The first-sign branch of tubashshira meets the coordinated warning verb under one purpose lām. The warning's danger notice and the protective-barrier sense at al-muttaqīn meet the facilitated message's readiness, so notice can confirm a self-guarding stance and invite protection among resistant hearers.
findings.reader_payoff: Instead of reading the audiences as simply one group comforted and another condemned, the reader can see one message working prospectively—affirming protection in one audience and making room for it in another.
findings.containment: This is attributed to a legacy-unbound trace and remains a possible local function, not a claim that the groups are fixed, that protection is achieved, that an announced outcome is completed, or that a specific obstruction was overcome.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is legacy_unbound, but its roots and word coordinates match the focus surface; local purpose syntax and audience forms ground the contact while the prospective function remains attributed.
